annotation.justification: The clause is clear and does not permit multiple materially different interpretations. It specifies that a user agent should include a Content-Length header in a request message under two conditions: (1) when no Transfer-Encoding is sent, and (2) when the request method has a defined meaning for enclosed content. These conditions are unambiguous and do not leave room for conflicting interpretations that would affect implementation behavior.
